orientation: A voluntary cultural overtone to existing institutions, never a replacement or compulsory membership.
practices: Ask what may travel and what must stay local.
Choose TAKE, HOLD or PASS without penalty.
Distinguish a proposal from an agreed act.
Ask a separate receiver to acknowledge the result.
Let every host adapt the method or decline it.

profiles.title: Food access / community grocery
profiles.question: Which single handoff would become easier if its receiver could HOLD, REFUSE, and independently confirm what happened?
profiles.offer: Rehearse one fictional food-shelf question before asking a real organizer to review the method.
gates: The actual food steward owns custody and food safety.
No real inventory, money, or beneficiary data is represented by this demo.

profiles.title: Church / voluntary fellowship
profiles.question: Can one optional supper or musical gathering leave one useful, independently confirmed act?
profiles.offer: Inspect a printable field kit without presuming sponsorship or compulsory participation.
profiles.firstName: Jubilee Circuit · table and road kit
gates: A named authorized host decides whether to use a venue.
Prayer and worship are voluntary; safeguarding is independent.

profiles.title: University / community research lab
profiles.question: Can independent offline devices preserve a source, a proposal, and a refusal without central authority?
profiles.offer: Test two separate keys and signed local packets on approved devices before discussing any real pilot.
gates: University access, compute, data and branding are not granted.
A digital demo is not a verified Linux installation or a real field test.

profiles.title: Festival / artists / mobile crew
profiles.question: Can music carry an invitation forward without turning the audience into members?
profiles.offer: Start with a print-only gathering kit and preserve the right to decline any next task.
gates: Hosts, organizers and artists retain their own decisions.
No event, fee, power draw, safety service or volunteer role is authorized.

profiles.title: Independent care / mutual aid
profiles.question: How can a need become an authorized question without becoming a permanent dossier about a person?
profiles.offer: Use fictional needs to explore locally owned offers and refusals without collecting personal records.
gates: Never put survivor, health, child or shelter details into public packets.
No case management, emergency service or live placement is offered.

profiles.title: Farm / cooperative / producer
profiles.question: Which bounded change could travel between independently owned systems without transferring their decisions?
profiles.offer: Draft one public-safe integration question, then leave actual system selection and data grants to the operators.
gates: There is no assumed provider, API, order or commercial partner.
Purchase, charitable support and volunteer work remain separate.

profiles.title: Library / civic table / neighbor host
profiles.question: What can a gathering teach the next one without imposing a central membership?
profiles.offer: Rehearse a small public-safe ask/return card and let the local host decide whether to repeat it.
gates: Venue permission and privacy policy belong to the host.
No library patron information or organizational endorsement is implied.

profiles.title: Independent person / founding circle
profiles.question: What can we found that remains usable and free when its founder leaves?
profiles.offer: Create a self-attested local room with a separate key and a right of refusal.
gates: Self-attested genesis is neither verified human identity nor legal incorporation.
Independent groups retain their own operating rules and can freely exit.
